Field note

Run a trial to watch Fern work. Rewind a mistake and guide her through a better approach.

How to play

  1. Read the flock. Sheep move away from Fern. A wide loop gets her behind a stray. At the gate, ease off if the sheep start to scatter.
  2. Show one correction. During a trial, choose Rewind & coach to go back five field seconds. Hold or drag in the field to steer. Aim nearby to slow down. Release to stop. Each round allows three saved lessons.
  3. Train a generation. Select examples and split six practice blocks between drills. Fern imitates your steering, then learns from rewards in 84 simulated runs. She earns points for moving the flock toward the gate and penning sheep. Stress and elapsed time cost points.
  4. Test both dogs. Replay a saved mistake or draw a fresh qualification field. Both dogs face identical sheep. Choose either saved model for future trials.
Controls and scoring

While coaching, focus the field and use the arrow keys or WASD to steer. Hold Shift to run. One break records up to seven seconds after your first input.

Trials rank sheep penned first, then lower average flock stress, then quicker time. Qualify by penning all eight on an unseen field. Earn a clean card for each of the three drills.
